invalidation_reason: The first implementation used an endpoint clamp tolerance of about 1e-6 cm because the tolerance scale included the global dry-end magnitude. That is much wider than the observed S-to-h floating roundoff and was not numerically frozen in the contract. Run 34337003822 is therefore implementation shakeout only, regardless of its conclusion.
purpose: Test whether the three genuine C1 interpolation-accuracy failures can be removed without changing the physical face law, runtime complexity or 262144-byte shared-class memory ceiling.

unchanged_physical_representation.constitutive_family: same unimodal Mualem-van Genuchten KSATFIT law as C1

candidate_representation_change.interpolation_arithmetic: convert four table entries to float64 and evaluate bilinear interpolation in float64
candidate_representation_change.candidate_selection: smallest shared-memory candidate passing all frozen characterization criteria on every stress material

endpoint_roundoff_policy.clamp_allowed_only_when: the reconstructed value lies outside the exact frozen boundary by no more than the corresponding formula above

exit_rule.characterization_pass: freeze the selected N and float32 representation before any new 36-material holdout
exit_rule.characterization_fail: reject this dense-table refinement family fail-closed

scope_guard: No KSATEXM, other hydraulic families, saturation switching, heterogeneous profiles, timestep accuracy, processes, bottom boundaries, groundwater, MultiSWAP, real-table response tangents or FullRichards equivalence.
